title: Argentina's Second Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development, Argentine Republic
temporal_coverage: Observed climate trends mainly cover 1960–2010; the Adaptation Communication also summarizes regional vulnerabilities and end-century RCP8.5 projections.
methodology: Second NDC Adaptation Communication summarizes climate observations, projections and regional vulnerabilities.
limitations: Regional impacts draw on earlier assessments; dates, scenarios and local population data vary.

title: Tools for understanding the dynamics of the 7 March 2025 flood in Bahía Blanca
organization: Instituto Nacional del Agua, Hydraulic Laboratory, Argentina
temporal_coverage: Technical analysis of the 7 March 2025 flood, using event observations and a preliminary hydrodynamic model.
methodology: INA combines public-video flood marks, hydrological data and a 2D hydrodynamic model for the four urban watersheds.
limitations: First version; sparse public observations and simplified channel/terrain inputs limit precision.

title: Resolution 532/2025: Supplement for Reconstruction rules, updated text
organization: Ministry of National Security, Argentine Republic
temporal_coverage: Rules for the one-time housing recovery subsidy after the 7 March 2025 Bahía Blanca flood, including July 2025 amendments.
methodology: Official legal text defines eligibility, payment zones, verification and monitoring procedures for the SUR subsidy.
limitations: The regulation establishes program rules, not the number of eligible applicants, payments made or resulting recovery.

title: Storm impacts and resources sent to Bahía Blanca
temporal_coverage: Provincial emergency update at 18:00 on 7 March 2025.
methodology: Provincial government emergency communication lists reported rainfall and resources deployed during the response.
limitations: This is an event-day government update, not an independent evaluation or a record of final outcomes.

title: National Plan for Disaster Risk Reduction 2025–2029
organization: National System for Integral Risk Management and Civil Protection, Argentina
temporal_coverage: National disaster-risk priorities and targets for 2025–2029.
methodology: Government summary describes the plan's objectives, participatory formulation and expected 2029 results.
limitations: The webpage reports planned objectives and expected results; it does not establish implementation or achievement.

title: Water situation and runoff forecast for Mendoza, 2026–2027 season
organization: Department General of Irrigation, Government of Mendoza Province
temporal_coverage: Observed 2025–2026 runoff and provincial flow forecasts for the 2026–2027 water season.
methodology: Provincial water authority reports seasonal river-flow forecasts based on year-round monitoring and nine automated stations.
limitations: The webpage summarizes seasonal volumes and does not state uncertainty ranges or climate-model scenarios.
